scope: Independent read-only replay, small adjacent synthetic counterexamples, package and restoration; not P5/P6 or performance research.

findings.title: Overlapping off-grid loans not accumulated
findings.demonstrated: R1 14:00-20:00 Paris and R2 14:30-19:30 Paris; source 4 IDE/minimum3. Three admissible plans contain both; primary with S01/R1/R2 is APPROVED_IN_DEMO.

findings.title: shared_unit with unknown lending_unit remains approvable
findings.demonstrated: lending_unit=None is accepted; no lender slots reserved; automatic and manual plans can be approved.

findings.title: Old cached capacity reused after new snapshot lowers lender margin
findings.demonstrated: First loan with scheduled5/minimum3 held. New snapshot scheduled4/minimum3; second loan approved. setdefault retains capacity2 despite current margin1.

findings.title: Restored runner inherits pre-terminal ledger
findings.demonstrated: Package terminal105 records /237.139s; restored runtime102 records /229.062s. Missing103-105 =8.077s. restore.sh checks the package ledger, not the runtime target.

positive_boundary_control: Two same-hour loans in the same unchanged snapshot: first APPROVED_IN_DEMO, second REFUSED; holdings preserved.
